finding.headline: "The Extracurriculars Collapsed"
finding.problem: "He missed 3 Saturday matches. His coach noticed. I promised I'd manage and I can't. My son thinks I chose the baby over him."
finding.person: Mum who dropped her 8-year-old's football/ballet because of the newborn; child embarrassed, husband annoyed.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (keeping older-child routines alive) — or Module inside B-series bundle". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
